_comment: Maps this platform's governorate codes to the shapeName used by the
geoBoundaries ADM2 dataset, for the geographic dashboard's filled map.
Needed because ADM2 carries no ISO code for governorates (unlike ADM1,
where SA-01..SA-14 match our regions exactly), so the only join available
is the name — and the two sources transliterate Arabic differently:
109 of 150 match after normalising case, punctuation and the trailing
'Governorate'. The 41 below were resolved by hand; each was checked against
the region the governorate belongs to, because fuzzy matching alone is not
safe here — it proposed 'Dammam' -> 'Adam' and offered the single polygon
A null means no ADM2 polygon exists for that governorate. Those render
uncoloured rather than being given a neighbour's shape.

_unmapped.0501: Dammam — no ADM2 polygon. The dataset has no Dammam unit; the nearest fuzzy candidate was 'Adam', which is a different place entirely.
_unmapped.0214: Al-Muwayh — no ADM2 polygon. Fuzzy matching offered 'Al Mukhwah', which is Al-Makhwah (1204) in a different region.
_unmapped.0608: Al-Amwah — no ADM2 polygon. Same false candidate as 0214.

_uncertain.1207: Al-Qura -> 'Al Qara' is the weakest accepted match (0.75). Both are in Al-Baha region, which is why it was kept. Worth a second look if that area looks wrong on the map.
